party.help.mode.title: Search modes
party.help.mode.filter: Filter combines included or excluded students with score, party-count, and assistant conditions.
party.help.mode.pool: Character Pool finds records your owned and invested students can cover. Assistants are excluded from pool checks.
party.help.mode.single: Single Party only finds records where every selected student appears in the same party. Stars and assistant status are ignored.
party.help.filter.title: How conditions work
party.help.filter.include: Only records containing every selected student are shown. If you select multiple star levels for one student, any one of them can match.
party.help.filter.exclude: Exclude normally checks your own students. Enable assistant exclusion to check assistants too.
party.help.filter.scoreMove: Score jump does not filter results. It moves to the page nearest the entered score.
party.help.filter.assist: The assistant condition keeps only records that borrowed the selected student.
party.help.filter.duplicate: Turning duplicate allowance off removes records that repeat a student across owned and assistant slots.
party.help.summary.title: Statistics basis
party.help.summary.sample: Statistics use collected clear records for the currently selected season and difficulty.
party.help.summary.essential: Must-have students were used as owned students in at least 70% of platinum records.
party.help.summary.impact: High-impact students have a large gap between the best rank with them and the best rank without them.
party.help.summary.partyCount: Party Ratio shows the share of 1PT, 2PT, and 3PT+ clears within each rank range.
party.help.summary.top5: Top 5 Parties are ordered by how often the full composition appears, not by score.
students.help.stats.title: Reading student statistics
students.help.stats.rank: Ranks and usage counts are based on Total Assault and Grand Assault records collected by the site.
students.help.stats.synergy: Synergy is observed co-usage, not a guarantee that two students are mechanically optimal together.
students.help.stats.heatmap: Regular heatmap rates use 20,000 players as the denominator; LUNATIC rates use that season's LUNATIC clear count.
students.help.stats.star: Investment distribution uses the single latest sample season shown on the card.
students.help.stats.build: Skill investment guidance combines observed investment patterns with wiki analysis and is not an absolute requirement.
calc.help.raid.title: Raid calculation basis
calc.help.raid.elapsed: Enter elapsed time from the start of battle to the clear, not time remaining.
calc.help.raid.limit: Difficulty and time limit must match the battle rules; both affect the base score.
calc.help.raid.total: Adding calculation items sums their scores into the displayed total.
calc.help.reset: Changing difficulty, stage, or time limit clears the previous input.
calc.help.tactical.title: Joint Firing Drill calculation basis
calc.help.tactical.elapsed: Enter actual time spent in battle, not time remaining.
calc.help.tactical.limit: Enter the time limit in seconds first to convert between play time and score.
calc.help.tactical.total: Adding calculation items sums their scores into the displayed total.
